normative_extracts.spec_section: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide — Menu & Dialog Patterns
normative_extracts.quote: A disclosure or menu trigger must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls referencing the controlled container, and return focus to the trigger upon dismissal.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Compound primitives share an implicit state machine via Context, synchronizing ARIA attributes, keyboard focus order, and dismissal listeners without prescribing CSS.

production_failures.symptom: Dropdown fails to close on outside click or loses keyboard focus
production_failures.root_cause: Passing a custom component to asChild without forwarding refs and merging onClick/onKeyDown handlers drops the primitive's event listeners.
production_failures.mitigation: Ensure custom trigger components spread props and forward refs via React.forwardRef or ref props.

production_failures.symptom: Controlled modal flickers or ignores close button
production_failures.root_cause: Mixing defaultOpen with open props triggers dual-state desynchronization between internal and parent state.
production_failures.mitigation: Enforce a single source of truth via a controllable state hook that locks to either internal or external state.
